scope: Supported NSIS UI text sites in cable and native installers

runtimeQualification.fixtures: comments, escaped quotes, literal comment punctuation, dynamic output, added raw text rejection, unaudited language-reference rejection

limitations: Not a full NSIS parser; macro expansion and line continuation are not evaluated
LangString definitions and their translations are not qualified by marking a reference
Dynamic external/helper output needs separate runtime qualification
Builtin page translations, custom page layout and installer lifecycle require actual compiler/UI tests
